inlines.v: DESIRABLE, adjective 1. Worthy of desire; that is to be wished for with sincerity or earnestness. An easy address is a desirable accomplishment; real virtue is still more desirable 2. Pleasing; agreeable. All of them desirable young men. Ezekiel 23:6.
